desc: The second screen's Start menu (TTYD_COMPANION_WINDOW), Settings tab, Audio, the Jukebox's Track row: A there plays nothing in its own frame, it goes to the game as a tap (the form's row), and the game plays the track at the point its own Start menu could open; the help box there says it was sent. Also: the second screen's Settings tab has the features' form rows at all (their list was in the menu's own block, empty in its copy)
